goal: Expose CGKN as an installable personal Codex plugin with controlled local MCP tools and verify the protocol without changing the reviewed generation or delivery route.
acceptance_criteria: A valid cgkn personal plugin manifest and marketplace entry expose a local MCP server plus bounded companion instructions.
After MCP pickup is verified in a fresh Codex task, the standalone global use-cgkn skill is retired or reduced to the plugin-bundled guidance.
Generation execution requires a hash-valid ready capability brief and explicit confirmation, then delegates only to scripts/run_local_pipeline.py.
No MCP tool accepts an API key, invokes nested Codex, writes Agent-authored Provider candidate source, calls a packager directly, or adds a generation or delivery route.
Protocol-level MCP initialization, tool listing, positive tool calls, negative boundary cases, plugin validation, and applicable CGKN regressions pass.

The MCP server provides typed project initialization, context preparation, brief sealing, generation planning/execution, test execution, and status inspection tools with explicit read/write annotations.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: bounded Codex escalation usefulness and authority isolation
quality_metrics.target: a librarian-curated request and Codex response stay within configured budgets, preserve request identity, produce actionable guidance, and cannot assert formal evidence or delivery authority
quality_metrics.method: schema validation, deterministic contract tests, support-pipeline prompt tests, and an offline failed-generation replay

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: Codex discovers cgkn@personal and calls the local cgkn MCP server directly from a fresh task.
The plugin-internal use-cgkn skill is guidance only; all operational actions use typed cgkn_* MCP tools.
Provider credentials remain process-only and generation requires RUN_REVIEWED_PROVIDER plus a hash-valid ready brief.
Generated-project tests accept no arbitrary command and strip secret-like environment variables from the child process.

feedback: The personal plugin validated, installed, and was called successfully from a fresh read-only Codex CLI task. The status tool returned NOT_EVALUATED honestly. A credentialed Provider generation was not repeated in this plugin iteration because no credential is stored or accepted as a tool argument.

worked: A repository-owned stdio MCP server plus personal marketplace junction made CGKN available in Codex without adding a generation route or requiring nested Codex from a tool.
Protocol and subprocess tests exercised the positive handoff and secret, confirmation, test-command, and evidence-status boundaries.
did_not_work: The earlier standalone global skill was only prompt routing and could not provide enforceable tool schemas or server-side confirmation checks.
experiments: When the Codex process has a process-only Provider credential, run one disposable-project cgkn_generate call and retain the existing delivery manifest and project-test evidence without changing the plugin contract.
